---
title: "Letter of Recommendation"
---

If you are an undergraduate looking for a letter of recommendation, I recommend you ask me if you feel like I could write you a strong letter. Usually, a strong letter comes from a letter writer who knows you well and thinks highly of your work.

If you are interested in a letter from me, first send an inquiry.

## Materials Needed

Please provide the following:

- Statement of purpose
- Unofficial transcript
- A spreadsheet with all programs to which you are applying
- A document with anything else you would like me to know or to include in the letter

### Example Spreadsheet Format

The spreadsheet should include details about each program (two programs shown as examples):

| Program | Institution | Deadline | Status |
|---------|-------------|----------|--------|
| MA Political Science | McGill University | Jan 15 | Pending |
| PhD Political Science | University of Toronto | Dec 1 | Pending |
